annotation.title_clean: Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
annotation.title_en: Timeline for the Implementation of the EU AI Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, AI Office (AI Act Service Desk)
annotation.summary_en: This European Commission AI Act Service Desk page sets out when each part of the EU AI Act applies. It runs from entry into force on 1 August 2024 to 2 August 2028, when the rules for high-risk AI in Annex I regulated products apply. The dates reflect the amendments made by the Digital Omnibus on AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Entry into force 1 Aug 2024; general provisions, AI literacy and prohibitions apply 2 Feb 2025
General-purpose AI obligations and governance structures (national authorities, AI Board, Scientific Panel, Advisory Forum) by 2 Aug 2025
Transparency rules (Art. 50) and enforcement start 2 Aug 2026; new prohibitions on non-consensual sexual deepfakes and child sexual abuse material from 2 Dec 2026
At least one AI regulatory sandbox per Member State by 2 Aug 2027
Annex III high-risk rules apply 2 Dec 2027; Annex I high-risk rules for AI in regulated products apply 2 Aug 2028
